# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 85 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 85

Jesus said: "Adam was created from great power and great abundance, but he was not worthy of you. If he had been, he would never have tasted death."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Was created" — foregrounds the creation context
- "Great abundance" — wealth rendered as abundance
- "Never have tasted death" — "never" adds emphasis; "tasted death" follows the idiomatic tradition (Hebrews 2:9)
